Clear and secure

Confirm first. Pay safely.

Every checkout creates a unique GiftHub UG order reference. Our team confirms availability, delivery and the final total before sending the correct payment instructions privately.

How payment works

Four simple steps

  1. 01

    Build your order

    Add gifts to your bag, choose delivery details and select your preferred payment method.

  2. 02

    Create your reference

    Checkout opens WhatsApp with a unique reference beginning GHU. Keep it with your order.

  3. 03

    Wait for confirmation

    We confirm stock, delivery timing, any custom details and your final total before you pay.

  4. 04

    Pay using the confirmed details

    Use your order reference on the transfer, then send the transaction confirmation. We acknowledge payment before preparation begins.

Payment safety

GiftHub UG will never ask for your PIN, OTP, password or full card details.

Pay only after receiving confirmation from +256 771 956 299 or info@creedmotions.store. If a message feels unusual, contact us through these published details before paying.
